name: date-picker
title: Date picker
description: Picks a day or a range from a calendar, with a quick year.

CalendarDay.description: One day of the Calendar, to return from `renderDay`: the default day button, which picks, holds the arrow keys' focus and draws today, the pick and the range. Children replace the number, `aria-label` the full date as its name. Other props, `ref` included, go to the button, so a Tooltip can wrap it.

props.name: value
props.description: single: the picked day.

props.name: range
props.description: range: the picked range.

props.name: month
props.description: The first month shown. Defaults to the value's month, or today's.

props.name: months
props.description: Two months side by side (the range picker).

props.name: today
props.description: Today, for the dash. Defaults to now.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Days that can't be picked, on top of those outside `min`/`max` (weekends, booked days). Like those, they stay reachable with the arrow keys and are read as unavailable.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: Draws each day, for a mark, a name or a tooltip of your own. Return a `CalendarDay`, the default day button, so picking and the arrow keys keep working.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's (Sunday in en-US, Monday in pl-PL).

DatePickerPanel.description: The date picker's panel on its own, in place: the popover surface with the Calendar, month and year to pick, and the presets. Other props, `ref` included, go to the surface.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A day picked in the calendar or from the presets.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: As on Calendar: days that can't be picked, besides those outside min/max.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As on Calendar: draws each day; return a `CalendarDay`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts listed before the calendar: `[datePresets.today, datePresets.tomorrow]`. Picking one moves the calendar to its month.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's.

DatePicker.description: A date field: the kit Input's skin with a calendar icon; the Calendar opens 4px below, with month and year to pick. Other props, `ref` included, go to the trigger button.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: As on Calendar: days that can't be picked, besides those outside min/max.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As on Calendar: draws each day; return a `CalendarDay`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts listed before the calendar: `[datePresets.today, datePresets.tomorrow]`. Picking one picks its day and closes.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target.

DateRangePicker.description: A range field: two months, Cancel and Apply in the footer. Picks wait for Apply. Picking an end before the start swaps them. Other props, `ref` included, go to the trigger button.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on Apply.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: As on Calendar: days that can't be picked, besides those outside min/max.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As on Calendar: draws each day; return a `CalendarDay`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts listed before the calendar: `[datePresets.last7Days, datePresets.last30Days]`. Picking one shows its range, which waits for Apply like any other.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `apply` label.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `cancel` label.

DateRangePickerPanel.description: The range picker's panel on its own, in place: the presets, two months, Cancel and Apply. Other props, `ref` included, go to the surface.

props.name: value
props.description: The range the panel starts from; picks stay in the panel until Apply.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Apply.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: As on Calendar: days that can't be picked, besides those outside min/max.

props.name: renderDay
props.description: As on Calendar: draws each day; return a `CalendarDay`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts listed before the calendar. Picking one shows its range; a range picked by hand leaves none selected.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 for Sunday. Defaults to the `dateLocale` label's.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `apply` label.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `cancel` label.
